versions.changelog:
qwencloud-model-selector v0.2.1

- Added four new reference guides: CLI usage, error handling, pricing disclaimer, and recommendation matrix.
- Migrated detailed recommendation logic, error diagnosis, and CLI-first strategy into new markdown files for modular lookup.
- Updated security and credential handling to clearly separate API key and CLI session, with strict red lines.
- Introduced a prioritized data resolution order to answer questions with authoritative or offline data, including recovery steps for CLI errors.
- Expanded the Default Recommendations section for common domains; pointed to the new matrix reference for specialized cases.

QwenCloud Model Selector 0.2.0

- Expanded skill triggers to include usage/billing checks and cost history.
- Updated task-to-model mapping: "Long context" and "Multimodal" now refer to qwen3.6-plus (prev. qwen3.5-plus).
- Scenario guidance for "one-off trial" now recommends using the qwencloud-usage skill.
- Various description and trigger clarifications; no implementation changes detected.

qwencloud-model-selector v0.1.0

- Initial release of an advisory skill to recommend the best QwenCloud model and parameters.
- Supports two main modes: interactive advisory (diagnostic questions) and cross-skill model resolution for execution skills.
- Only recommends officially listed Qwen models based on the latest reference data.
- Enforces strict security: never displays API keys or plaintext credentials.
- Provides model selection guidelines based on content type, task, priorities, and context size.
- Includes special handling and model eligibility warnings for Coding Plan users.
